name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Revenue Operations & GTM Systems Architect | HubSpot, Salesforce, Automation & AI
summary: GTM operator and systems architect with 15+ years across sales, onboarding, and customer success in SaaS, including 5+ years designing CRM and automation systems end to end. Has carried a quota, onboarded 25+ customers a month, and led a team of 20, so diagnoses friction from the rep's seat and then builds the fix as part of a connected system across HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, and the automation layer between them. Spent 15+ years cooking in restaurants before this career and understands how independent restaurant owners think and operate.

Integrate CRMs with client systems through Zapier, Make, and n8n, writing Python and JavaScript in custom code steps where native tools stop.
Develop full-lifecycle customer strategies spanning demand generation, sales CRM architecture, and customer success, and build dashboards tracking funnel progression, ROI, and pipeline velocity.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' loosely defined needs into precise technical requirements and AI agent logic.
